name: greenhouse_heating_pipe_dynamic
title: Greenhouse heating pipe rail: discretized dynamic model
summary: Six-day simulation (Brussels TMY, 10-15 Dec) of the pipe-rail heating circuit of a Venlo tomato greenhouse: five pipe cells in series with the water temperature as state (finite-volume energy balance), exchanging hindered convection and long-wave radiation with the climate core of CSL-0334; supply temperature and mass flow follow a weather-compensated schedule read from the lookup table.

verification.summary: The 145-row trajectory (15 states, hourly output) agrees with an independent RK4 integration (h = 30 s, same equations, same table): pipe cell temperatures within 0.0015 K, T_air within 0.018 K, VP_air within 1.1 Pa over six days.
verification.reference: greenhouse_heating_pipe_dynamic_ref.py in this folder (RK4, h = 30 s); climate core identical to CSL-0334, pipe cells follow eq. (28) of Altes-Buch et al.
verification.notes: max_rel_diff is the largest relative deviation of the 15 states over the trajectory (T_air). Integration step 60 s. At 120 s, against the same 30 s reference, VP_air drifts by about 1.2 % and T_air by 0.5 K. 2026-11-10: floor balance corrected (-q_rad_flr_cov) and the trajectory re-checked. The 25 min run of that day is obsolete: RK4 at 60 s is 0.94 s, BDF at 1e-4 is 0.15 s within 0.03 K (README, Solving time).
